term.name: single_item_shortcut
term.definition: Matching or coercing no item or one item without the frames of the type matcher or the coercion engine: the count against the occurrence, one item by the item rules alone, one item (or a node's one-item typed value) to an atomic type by the atomic coercion rules, one item to a choice by the first alternative it matches when that one keeps it; whatever they do not decide at once goes to the frames (internal, src/evaluator_function.c, , )
